description: Hand-authored seed quotations covering the hardest cases. All suppliers, people, addresses and prices are fictional. Seeds are development material: never part of the frozen test set and never used to tune prompts against test results.

hard_cases: GST-inclusive prices: GST must be backed out of the total, not added
document-level 5% discount whose exact value 24.745 rounds half-up to 24.75 (banker's rounding gives 24.74)
typos in labels: 'QUOTATON', 'disount'
unit synonyms: 'units' -> each, 'bx' -> box
DD/MM/YYYY date
thousands separators and $ symbols in every money cell
decimal quantity with superscript unit (6.5 m³)
line-level percent discount and line-level amount discount
lump-sum row with no quantity or unit price ('L/S' -> lot)
GST 10% exclusive with half-cent rounding (584.214 -> 584.21)
validity as an end date
no quote number, no date, no subtotal, no validity, no payment terms
GST/SST never mentioned: treatment not_stated, not 'not_charged'
typos kept verbatim in values ('Galvinised')
'Grand totl' typo on the total label
a delivery lead time that must not be read as validity
supplier arithmetic error on line 2 (4 x 18.75 = 75.00, printed 76.00): the label keeps the printed 76.00
free-of-charge row: 'FOC' -> unit price 0.00
credit row with negative unit price and line total
freight row with quantity but no unit
GST explicitly not applicable: treatment not_charged
part numbers kept out of descriptions
no table: every value is inside sentences
bare '$' with a New Zealand address: currency not_stated
'Ref: your enquiry 2219' is the customer's reference, not a quote number
quantity written in words ('three')
'plus GST' with no rate and no amount: rate and amount not_stated, total not_stated (do not invent 15%)
relative validity 'end of this month' resolved against the email date
conditional 2.5% early-payment discount belongs in payment_terms, not discounts
